issue: शिव कहँ भजहु असुर आराती: who worships whom; असुर आराती 'foe of the asuras' could be Śiva or Bhairava addressed.
our reading: Crying bam bam bam, you worship Śiva, the foe of the demons.
alternatives: 'You, foe of the demons, worship Śiva'; an imperative to the reader: 'worship Śiva'.

issue: साद भक्त को कारज सार्यो: साद a devotee's name (Sāda), or साध(ु) 'holy'.
our reading: the work of your devotee Sāda.

issue: तब चरणन: the book's तब 'then, so'; Drik Panchang तव 'your'.
our reading: so I bow my head daily at your feet (तब as printed; 'your' implied).
